sql: SELECT name,sql FROM main.sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name
SELECT * FROM runtime_runs WHERE run_id=?
SELECT * FROM runtime_episodes WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY episode_id
SELECT * FROM runtime_commission_intents WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY parent_episode_id,original_decision_index
SELECT * FROM runtime_actions WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY episode_id,decision_index
SELECT * FROM runtime_observations WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY episode_id,unit_index
SELECT episode_id,call_index,purpose,timing,length(request) AS request_characters,response IS NOT NULL AS response_present FROM runtime_model_calls WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY episode_id,call_index
SELECT call_index,purpose,request,timing FROM runtime_model_calls WHERE run_id=? AND episode_id=? ORDER BY call_index
SELECT decision_index,data FROM runtime_estimation_contexts WHERE run_id=? AND episode_id=? ORDER BY decision_index
SELECT * FROM runtime_report_attempts WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY parent_episode_id,decision_index
SELECT * FROM runtime_completion_slots WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY episode_id,sequence
SELECT form,facts FROM runtime_forms WHERE run_id=? AND episode_id=?
SELECT episode_id,receipt_kind,COUNT(*) AS count FROM runtime_record_receipts WHERE run_id=? GROUP BY episode_id,receipt_kind
SELECT receipt_index,record_ref,receipt_kind,source_index FROM runtime_record_receipts WHERE run_id=? AND episode_id=? ORDER BY receipt_index
PRAGMA main.table_info(episode_waits)
SELECT * FROM episode_waits WHERE run_id=? AND parent_episode_id=?
SELECT id,record_type,origin,data FROM records ORDER BY id
SELECT name,sql FROM durable.sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name
SELECT handle,operation_key,parent_episode_id,commission_sha256,spec,lifecycle_state,execution_identity,return_id,acknowledgment,failure FROM durable.commissions ORDER BY handle
SELECT handle,return_id,returned_at,envelope,cursor FROM durable.returns ORDER BY cursor
SELECT cursor,handle,event,record_ref,operation_key,observed_at FROM durable.events ORDER BY cursor
